title: Correct censored outcome maturity count and false-positive prospective validation flag
objective: Under existing Experiment Lifecycle ownership, correct the verified code-level miscount whereby registry.matured_outcome_count includes ANY outcome receipt including CENSORED; preserve all immutable source/outcome files and statuses, expose true status-separated, score-eligibility-aware research metrics with backward-compatible fail-closed contract semantics and repair consumer sensor_relationship_compression.current_prospective_validation to NEVER claim validation from censored-only receipts. Prefer a minimal existing-owner repair, not a new scorer, forecast engine, mutable historical backfill, portfolio change or independent admission. The existing build_calibration_population_census.py is the known status-filtered reference. Owner decides on schema version / consumer compatibility; no automatic promotion and no output claim of edge.

evidence.summary: registry uses matured=[outcomes[id]...] followed by len(matured) without status filter; sets MATURED_INCONCLUSIVE if censored-only
prospective_row marks current_prospective_validation=bool(matured_outcome_count), conflating censored-only with valid maturity
reference distinct outcome status count, computes actual matured only when status=MATURED

Cohort-restricted sample, NOT global outcome_memory census: 32 registry candidates with state MATURED_INCONCLUSIVE each have one CENSORED outcome; 17 presently nonqualified historically requalified candidates have 28 CENSORED outcome references; 10 receipts overlap both sets, so union is 50 distinct CENSORED receipts in these two specified cohorts. Independent Codex full outcome_memory enumeration at parent main 2e7ea6c found 92 distinct CENSORED forecast_id files across ALL statuses/cohorts. The 50 is a proven minimum subset, not total CENSORED; 20 SENSOR_COMBINATION censored-only true flags are a separate constrained sensor cohort. Source cohort predicate and comparison detailed in linked #1557 report.
original CENSORED outcome that registry currently counts as matured for EC-01d8e20aee64058a00b7
pinned baseline 509 candidates, 1004 raw outcome refs, 32 MATURED_INCONCLUSIVE
fresh main readback for intake, same target script Git blob SHA as prior forensic baseline

reproduction: Baseline main 2e7ea6c / exact registry blob d05ec191: derive cohort A = registry candidates with lifecycle_state/state == MATURED_INCONCLUSIVE (32 rows; inspect all linked outcome IDs, CENSORED); cohort B = registry candidates with scientific admission SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE_KEEP_SHADOW or TARGET_UNIT_QUARANTINED and matured_outcome_count > 0 (17 candidates, 28 linked outcome IDs, CENSORED); intersect forecast IDs -> 10, union -> 50 distinct linked CENSORED receipts. This is a restricted cohort, NOT a global count; independent Codex full research/framework_memory/outcome_memory/*.json census finds 92 CENSORED distinct forecast IDs in this baseline. Cross-check records by forecast_id and immutable outcome path and status; do not count outcome refs as eligible maturity. A controlled fixture with one admitted SENSOR_COMBINATION candidate, frozen forecast and CENSORED outcome currently yields registry.matured_outcome_count=1, state=MATURED_INCONCLUSIVE and prospective_row.current_prospective_validation=True under current source; a genuine MATURED eligible HIT/MISS is the positive control. Confirm 20 censored-only sensor flags. Keep all source bytes unchanged.

positive: Exactly one immutable outcome with status=MATURED, result=HIT, scientifically score eligible yields true matured count=1, correctly recorded HIT, proper supported lifecycle and prospective validation only where contract and admission permit.
Exactly one eligible MATURED/MISS yields correct negative maturity state and no unsupported promotion; keep negative controls and research-only authority.
Mixed records (one eligible MATURED plus one CENSORED) retain 2 total outcome records, 1 truly matured, 1 censored; stable immutable IDs and deterministic rebuild independent of enumeration order.

Existing registry consumers and monthly council/yield/weekly adjudication retain explicit compatibility or versioned failure-closed behavior; focused test suites pass on exact branch then verified main after governed merge.
negative: One CENSORED-only outcome yields 1 retained outcome record and 1 censored count, ZERO actual matured and ZERO score eligible; prospectively validated=false. Do not incorrectly erase or rewrite censored historical record.

All 32 present MATURED_INCONCLUSIVE cases remain documented as censored/UNKNOWN, not MATURED HIT/MISS; all 20 affected SENSOR_COMBINATION rows must not claim current_prospective_validation=true; preserve historical evidence without prospective retrofit.

A semantic duplicate, historically requalified, target-unit-quarantined or unadmitted candidate cannot become current prospective validated merely from a positive raw outcome_record_count or current admission status.

A malformed, unknown, conflicting, missing or duplicate outcome status cannot silently become MATURED/eligible; explicit error/UNKNOWN where evidence unavailable. No clock backdating or creation of new outcome files.
Reject counting an outcome with status=MATURED but scientific_score_eligible=false/null as an eligible scored forward test; separate MATURED physical status from eligible score.
Reproducibility under rerun, unchanged raw outcome SHA; no trades, market threshold changes, API calls, new workflow or auto-promotions.

forbidden_changes: historical outcome or frozen forecast rewrites
post_fix_gate: Owner chooses versioned compatibility with downstream weekly/yearly consumers; focused positive/negative tests and exact-head CI; independent nonauthoring review; governed merge; main SHA and unchanged immutable outcome SHA readback; later natural regenerated registry and sensor readout verified with no false prospective flag, no scientific edge promotion. Remediation maturation controller alone owns CODEX_READY, not the research thread.
